brief.topic: Sahih Muslim 2999: good in every affair of the believer
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Sahih Muslim 2999: for the believer, gratitude in good times and patience in hard times both turn into good.

hooks.notes: Everyone is in one of the two; the hadith covers both.

hooks.text: Both can be good for you
Strange are the ways of a believer
hooks.notes: Quote belongs in the source scene.

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: Good day or hard day? / This hadith speaks to both.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.
scenes.excerpt: for if he has an occasion to feel delight, he thanks (God), thus there is a good for him in it, and if he gets into trouble and shows resignation (and endures it patiently), there is a good for him in it

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / Two responses / On a good day: gratitude. On a hard day: patience. Notice which one you are in today, and answer it the way this hadith describes.
body: On a good day: gratitude. On a hard day: patience.

caption.opening: Whatever kind of day you're having, this hadith has a response for it.
body: Sahih Muslim 2999: gratitude in ease, patience in hardship, and good in both for the believer.
Today: name which one you are in, and answer it.
